verdict.rationale: Docs show Slack app integration where agent interacts directly in workspace, plus agent-behavior setting where 'agent only responds to comments containing explicit mentions' (tagging), and Slack/Jira/Linear notifications and comment/task creation support delegation of bugs/tasks. However evidence is all first-party docs with no hands-on demonstration of the actual @-mention chat UX or thread-based discussion flow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of tagging-in-thread UX, example of a full back-and-forth discussion thread, and clarity on which chat surfaces (Slack vs GitHub PR comments vs Linear) support this exact mention-to-delegate flow.
